input.title: Ridgeview roof (R. Finley) — billing reconciliation: duplicate $8,400 vendor bill
input.description:
Tracking the billing status of the Ridgeview structural roof repair. Owner: Robert Finley. Approved scope: $8,400. Vendor per approval paperwork: Pete Donovan Roofing.

Current status (as of 7/1/2026):
- Owner approval on file for the $8,400 scope (failed-flashing removal/replacement, structural decking repair, full reseal/waterproofing, ridge-cap replacement, chimney/vent re-flashing, cleanup). Physical invoice 2026-481 breaks this out as $7,400 roofing work + $1,000 Star PM administrative/vendor-management fee (13.51%).
- Owner AR invoice 2026-494 issued to Robert Finley for $8,400 (open balance) — this is the single, correct owner pass-through.

BILLING ISSUE (why the picture didn't reconcile cleanly):
- Two open vendor bills exist for the SAME job, both booked to vendor "Big Bend Restoration," both $8,400, both dated 5/1: DocNumbers 2026-481 and PD-2026-084 → $16,800 sitting in AP. This is a duplicate.
- Vendor-name mismatch: approval/paperwork references "Pete Donovan Roofing" but the QB bills are under "Big Bend Restoration."
- A duplicate physical invoice copy also exists on the shared drive (2026-481 and 2026-481-makeready).

Real owner exposure: $8,400 (the approved amount) — provided the duplicate vendor bill is voided before any disbursement from the Ridgeview owner reserve. If both vendor bills are paid, the owner/reserve is over-exposed by an extra $8,400.

Action needed: Accounting (Teresa Wood / Linda Castillo) to void one of the two duplicate vendor bills and reconcile the vendor name before releasing funds from the Ridgeview reserve; confirm AR 2026-494 remains the single $8,400 owner charge.

(Note: a separate Alamo HVAC estimate EST-2026-0217 for ~$1,410 on "Ridgeview Plaza" common HVAC and a $175 A Plus Carpet duplicate-fee credit are unrelated to this roof scope and remain pending owner approval / reconciliation.)

input.subject: Property Operations Update — 208B AC, Ridgeview roof billing, Mitchell move-out
input.body:
Hi Aurora,

Quick operations update before I head out, covering the three items I wanted verified against source data rather than secondhand notes. Here's the actual situation on each.

1) Sunset Ridge 208B — AC (URGENT / life-safety)
The early read from Tony was a clogged filter with a Thursday PM-round fix. That is NOT what the inspection found. Alamo HVAC completed an on-site inspection today and diagnosed a COMPRESSOR FAILURE — the unit cannot be restored by a filter replacement. They classify it as a life-safety condition in this summer heat (the tenant, Gabriella Torres, has been without AC since last night and has a young child at home), and advise it should not wait for a routine Thursday slot.
- Emergency compressor replacement: $1,840 gross ($650 labor + $900 compressor/refrigerant + $290 diagnostic), less a $290 prior-visit service credit (ref CM-2026-SR208) = $1,550 net.
- Alamo is standing by for authorization to schedule immediately.
- Done: updated the maintenance ticket (MT-2026-063) to High with the inspection findings, corrected the Linear item (OPS-231) to Urgent, and posted the correction in #maintenance so the team stops working off the filter/Thursday version. This needs an authorization decision quickly.

2) Ridgeview roof — billing / owner exposure (needs accounting cleanup before payment)
The "$8,400 approved scope" is real and correct as the owner number: Robert Finley's approval is on file, and he's been invoiced once for $8,400 (AR invoice 2026-494, open). For context, that $8,400 = $7,400 of vendor roofing work + a $1,000 Star PM admin/vendor-management fee (13.51%).
The reason the billing didn't come out clean: there are TWO open vendor bills for the same job — both $8,400, both dated 5/1, both booked to "Big Bend Restoration" (DocNumbers 2026-481 and PD-2026-084) — i.e., $16,800 sitting in payables. That's a duplicate. There's also a vendor-name mismatch (approval paperwork says Pete Donovan Roofing; the bills are under Big Bend Restoration), and a duplicate copy of the physical invoice on the drive.
- Real owner exposure: $8,400 (the approved amount) — as long as the duplicate vendor bill is voided before any disbursement from the Ridgeview reserve. If both bills get paid, the owner/reserve would be over-exposed by an extra $8,400.
- Done: opened a Linear issue (OPS-1000) capturing the full status and flagging the duplicate; there was no existing roof issue to update. Action item is with accounting (Teresa/Linda) to void one bill and reconcile the vendor name before releasing reserve funds.

3) Tanya Mitchell — move-out status
This is an eviction in progress, not a voluntary move-out. She breached her payment plan (missed the 6/23 installment, no response), a 3-Day Notice to Pay or Quit was served 6/26 with a 6/29 deadline she did not cure, and as of today the eviction petition is being coordinated with the Justice of the Peace. The make-ready turn is on the board as Scheduled but is tentative and contingent on the court outcome — no turnover work can start until the legal process concludes and possession is returned.
- Unit: Sunset Ridge, Unit 14 (confirmed via her tenant file and the eviction-track records). One heads-up: there are conflicting internal references tying her to "Unit 4B / Las Palmas 4B" from the earlier payment-plan phase — I'd flag that for cleanup, but the move-out/eviction unit is Sunset Ridge 14.

Happy to walk through any of these when I'm back.

Thanks,
Denise
